description: DolphinX connects your SEO and AI search (LLMO) monitoring data to ChatGPT. Ask about your search rankings, how often your brand is mentioned or cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overview and other AI answers, how you compare to competitors, and why AI recommends you (or doesn't). Access is read-only and limited to exactly what you can already see in your own DolphinX account.
